## If you've run a job,  you've seen these problems

These are the challenges that show up when

scattered tools and processes start running

your jobs.

![](https://redteam.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/icon-sync.svg)

### Project info scattered everywhere

You’re hunting for drawings, RFIs, and contracts across email, Dropbox, and filing cabinets. Somewhere in there is the latest version.

![](https://redteam.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/icon-chart-updated.svg)

### Job costs are hard to track in real time

Tracking budgets and change orders manually can turn small delays into real cash flow problems. Especially when the numbers are buried in Excel or QuickBooks.

![](https://redteam.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/icon-flow.svg)

### No single source of truth

Field teams, PMs, and office staff work in silos, so project status gets pieced together through calls, texts, and emails. This is how confusion and costly mistakes start to happen.

![](https://redteam.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/icon-hand.svg)

### Too much work is still manual

Bid invites, subcontracts, and change orders are built by hand, one job at a time. That's fine when you're small. It's a problem when you're trying to grow.

RedTeam is designed for small and midsize commercial GCs outgrowing tools like Excel, Word, and Dropbox. It brings the back office, field, and project documents into one centralized place.

Eliminate the lag time in job costing. Get up-to-date insight into budgets, profitability, and WIP reporting while the project is still in progress. Not after the job is over.

### Built-in workflows   that guide the job

RedTeam helps your team follow a clear, consistent way to manage jobs, with workflows built around construction best practices from estimate to closeout.

Work with a team that stays in it with you through onboarding and beyond, helping your field and office teams get started faster and build consistent processes from day one.

## The questions GCs ask

Still have questions?

[Book a Call](https://redteam.com/book-a-demo/)

##### What is RedTeam?

RedTeam is construction management software built for small and mid-sized commercial GCs to manage [projects](https://redteam.com/construction-project-management-software/), [financials](https://redteam.com/construction-financial-management-software/), documents, and team coordination in [one connected platform](https://redteam.com/platform/).

##### What if spreadsheets and our current tools are working well enough?

They may work for a while. But as you grow, scattered tools make it harder to track documents, workflows, and job costs in one place.

##### Is RedTeam too big or is it overkill for my business?

No. RedTeam is built for small and mid-sized commercial GCs, with practical workflows and guardrails that fit how growing contractors actually work.

##### Will it be hard for our team to learn?

RedTeam gives your team structured workflows and hands-on support, so you’re not starting from scratch or figuring it all out alone.

##### Why choose RedTeam over a big-name construction management platform?

Many growing GCs feel underserved and overcharged by enterprise-first platforms. RedTeam gives your team ongoing support from setup through every stage of the project, with [predictable pricing and no surprise fees](https://redteam.com/pricing/).
